intent.title: Synthetic list, filter, and export draft
intent.audience: Synthetic users evaluating a local-only list workflow
intent.outcome: Display synthetic items, filter them by category, and export the filtered rows as CSV.
constraints: Require no login, network service, or external integration.

requirements.statement: Display a list of synthetic items with names and categories.
Filter the displayed items by a selected category.
Export the currently filtered items as CSV.

acceptance_cases.given: Three synthetic items in two categories
acceptance_cases.then: All three item names and categories are visible
Only items in that category remain visible

acceptance_cases.when: The CSV export action is requested
acceptance_cases.then: The exported CSV contains only the filtered synthetic items
